en: The front of the postcard features two images: on the left, a photograph of a traditional building with a timber-framed facade and outdoor seating, surrounded by trees, labeled as 'Sommerfrische – Sennhütte bei Bad Pyrmont 1000 Fuss über dem Meeresspiegel.' On the right, there is an interior shot showing a large, simply decorated dining room with long tables and wooden chairs. The text is in German. The reverse shows a divided back for message and address, handwritten script, a green Deutsche Reich postage stamp, and a postmark from 'PYRM'. There is also a blue stamp for 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT'.
